drafted_from: tool:find-glitches-in-a-generated-voice-take's own row (its words, invoke, input and output schema) in tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json; it runs on the person's computer and has no sample run here, so this kit is a draft until a real run's answer is put in
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check my generated voice take /Work/demo/take.wav with its word times /Work/demo/take.words.json for breathy words, pitch breaks, clicks and stretched words." It runs tool:find-glitches-in-a-generated-voice-take on your computer and names each flagged word.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads a take and its word times on your computer and writes a qc file beside the take.
instructions: 1. Install python3, numpy and librosa, and clone the Workshop (git clone https://github.com/Trillion-X/trillion-workshop.git).

2. Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs its run command on your computer: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/check_voice_take.py /Work/demo/take.wav /Work/demo/take.words.json
3. Read take.qc.json: each flagged word and why; regenerate or repair those words before using the take.
